heading: Short title
lead: This subchapter may be cited as the “Aleutian and Pribilof Islands Restitution Act”.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 1989c of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: RESTITUTION FOR WORLD WAR II INTERNMENT OF JAPANESE-AMERICANS AND ALEUTS
